_comment: SDR fleet policy v2 (SB7, 2026-07-04) — SINGLE-HOST deployment on the M1 Mac mini (Intel mini = cold spare). Source of truth for device->role allocation, RSPduo modes, USB grouping, and tuner-broker invariants. The broker, config generators, and wiring card all read THIS file. Address devices by serial ONLY; USB position is never trusted. Digital engine is SDRTrunk (native SDRplay API — it still MUST claim its serial through the broker so nothing else opens the device). op25 is retired (no macOS path). See docs/sb7-northstar-program.md §4.

host.cold_spare: Mac mini 2018 Intel (16 GB, macOS Sequoia ceiling — security updates end ~fall 2027)

invariants._why: Two concurrent dual-tuner RSPduos through ONE sdrplay apiService deterministically segfault it (0x6bed) and corrupt live IQ. Single host = single apiService, so at most one device (RSP-A, and only after the D1 gate) may be dual-tuner; the broker REFUSES any second dual-tuner claim.
invariants._why_gap: The apiService does not safely serialize concurrent sdrplay_api_Open calls from different processes, even across different physical RSPduos.

rspduo_daemon._note: One apiService brokers BOTH RSPduos for chirp (via SoapySDRPlay3) AND SDRTrunk (native API). All opens funnel through the tuner-broker, spaced by rspduo_open_gap_sec. SDRTrunk launches once and stays up — no restart churn near this daemon.

devices.label: RSP-DIGITAL
devices._ladder: D3 ships Single Tuner / one P25 system. D1 (after the alert stack is live) flips SDRTrunk to native Dual Tuner mode for two systems — set dual_tuner=true then; app restart required; verify each system's channel span fits ~2 MHz/tuner first (docs/sb7-northstar-program.md §4.1b).

devices.label: RSP-AIRBAND
devices._note: ST = the proven-clean airband config (2026-06-15). chirp still calls set_bandwidth explicitly (chirp/dsp/source_sdr.py) — keep bandwidth_hz set even though ST tolerates a driver default.

devices.serial_status: confirmed-on-micro; re-verify + reflash if needed in SB7.1
devices.label: GROUND
devices._note: Ground NFM on RTL is the proven 2026-06-18 fix. Gain 30-35 (40 clips the V4-class front end).

devices.serial_status: confirmed-on-micro (RTL-SDR Blog V4, USB-finicky — error -71 re-enumeration history; prefer the best hub port; candidate to demote to spare if instability recurs)

FLEX
